nodes.label: Docker Compose Stack Definition
nodes.description: 8-service Docker Compose stack. Base profile: db (MySQL 8, ROW binlog, 7-day retention), redis (7-alpine, AOF everysec), back (Laravel), front (Vite SPA). Workers profile: debezium (CDC from binlog), outbox-cdc-consumer (XREADGROUP/XAUTOCLAIM from CDC streams), raw-consumer (raw:consume --block=5000), domain-event-consumer (domain:consume --block=5000). Optional queue profile: queue (php artisan queue:work). Ingestion service: Python MQTT adapter. Volumes: db_data, redis_data, back_vendor, front_node_modules, ingestion_spool. Healthchecks on all core services. DEBEZIUM_DB_PASSWORD required.
nodes.rationale: Defines the complete Docker infrastructure. Shows the CDC pipeline topology (MySQL binlog → Debezium → CDC streams → consumers), the worker profiles, and the healthcheck dependencies. Critical for understanding the deployment architecture.
